records.name: Pin 14 (VCC) Disconnected
records.effect: No output logic generated. IC internal gates remain inactive.
records.reason: IC requires +5V power supply to operate internal transistor gates.
records.fix: Connect Pin 14 to +5V VCC power rail using a Red wire.

records.name: Pin 7 (GND) Floating
records.effect: Unstable reference voltage. Output voltage undefined.
records.reason: IC requires ground reference connection for return current path.
records.fix: Connect Pin 7 to GND ground rail using a Black wire.

records.name: Input Pin Floating
records.effect: Input pin state is floating (neither HIGH nor LOW).
records.reason: Unconnected CMOS/TTL logic inputs pick up ambient noise.
records.fix: Connect input pin to DIP switch, +5V, or GND rail.

records.name: LED Connected Without Resistor
records.effect: Excessive current flow through output LED.
records.reason: LED forward voltage is ~2.0V; 5V directly causes thermal breakdown.
records.fix: Insert a 330Ω current limiting resistor in series with LED cathode to GND.
